narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Three thousand sixty is divisible by four, so it is divisible by eight too.
<bookmark mark='three'/>For eight, read the last three digits: zero six zero, which is sixty. Eight sevens are fifty six, so four is left.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Passing four does not mean passing eight, although passing eight always means passing four.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, divide one number by a divisor you marked yes and see that nothing is left.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Use the quick test for each column first, then let the links catch any slips.

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says three thousand sixty is divisible by four, so it is divisible by eight too. Its last three digits make sixty, and sixty is not a multiple of eight.
